THE 6.4L HEMI® V8 WITH VCT AND MDS. Long-proven and capable over the long run, the 6.4L HEMI V8 credentials start with what counts: best-in-class gas towing2
and best-in-class gas payload.2 Assets here include VCT (Variable Cam Timing) for consistent power across a wide torque band, Multi-Displacement System (MDS)/Fuel Saver
Technology, which delivers 4-cylinder efficiencies during highway cruising, the interactive Deceleration Fuel Shut-Off (iDFSO) feature—and finally, a new 8-speed automatic
transmission. The 6.4L HEMI V8 is power, performance and efficiency that won’t let you down.
THE NEW ZF 8HP75 8-SPEED AUTOMATIC. New for Ram Heavy Duty, the 6.4L HEMI V8 comes mated to the smooth-shifting TorqueFlite® 8HP75 8-speed automatic.
There are more than 40 individual shift maps to refine shift points for optimal efficiency, performance and drivability. The transmission uses shift-by-wire technology, eliminating
a mechanical linkage between the transmission and the gear selector. The 2019 Ram Heavy Duty uses an innovative and new rotary shifter mounted on the left side of the
instrument panel’s center stack—in Black or Satin Chrome, depending on trim level.
